$comment: Merged over the effective pxtarget.json only when the build runs with FWD_BOARDS=1 (forward/docs/device-picker.md, phase 1). Without the flag the build is exactly the micro:bit editor.
apply-overlay.js copies each forward/overlay/boards/libs/<board> into the build, and forward/build/inject-boards.js bundles it after staticpkg.

dynamicBoardDefinition: a project's core board package ("core": true) supplies board.json and the compile variant. micro:bit projects have no board package, so they keep today's universal hex and stay openable on makecode.microbit.org.

fwdpico: placeholder until codal-forward-brain builds for the Pico (plan M7). The service id and docker image name the Forward build that will make those images; no image exists yet, so Pico projects can't download.

fwdmicrorgb (MicroRGB, hw-microbit-clone, nRF52833): placeholder until Forward's CODAL target for it exists (forked from codal-microbit-v2; the repository name here is provisional). UF2 family 0x621e937a is the registered nRF52833 family (the board uses a UF2 bootloader on native USB); the flash limits are copied from mbcodal and must be re-checked against the bootloader's layout. WebUSB (HF2 in the runtime) and the USB VID/PID come later. It builds with the same toolchain as micro:bit V2 (the fwd-codal image).
